_meta.description: Intuit QuickBooks Online OAuth 2.0 refresh-token exchange. POST to the bearer token endpoint with HTTP Basic auth (base64(client_id:client_secret)) and a form body grant_type=refresh_token + refresh_token. Intuit ROTATES the refresh token on every exchange — the returned refresh_token MUST be persisted or the next refresh 400s with invalid_grant. access_token lives ~3600s; the refresh token lives x_refresh_token_expires_in (~101 days). Doc-derived; tokens are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization/oauth-2.0 (POST oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer, Basic client auth, grant_type=refresh_token; response access_token/refresh_token(rotated)/expires_in/x_refresh_token_expires_in)
